text: --- Page 1 --- MONSTER HUNTER: WORLD / GUIDE Great Sword [!NOTE] Please refer to the MHWI Damage Formula and MHWI General Data Sheet by MoonBunnie & Deathcream for up to date information. The Great Sword (GS) is a slow, heavy weapon that sacrifices attack speed for attack strength. Learning how to use the GS effectively requires good positioning, anticipation, and understanding of the GS's attack timings. Overcharging a charged slash will reduce its strength to Level 2. Timing it in response to a monster's attack allows the player to continue their Charged Slash combo without interruptions. The Level 3 charged slash is performed by releasing <<T>> at the right time. Overcharging will cause Level 3 charged slashes to revert to the power of a Level 2 charge, so timing is critical to maximize damage. Although Level 3 charged slashes are preferable, landing a Level 2 charged slash is still better than missing completely with a Level 3 charged slash. The GS's slow attack and large [[moti

Movelist In addition to the GS Charge Slashes above, the GS has a multitude of other attack chains. Mid-air attacks are done in the air, such as after hopping off a ledge, jumping off a vine, or climbing up a wall and jumping off.
